Speed is increased after this ability. |music-1 = [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Equinox (Awakened Fallen King Theme)|thumb|center|250px]] |music-ingame-1 = [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Equinox In-Game Version|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|AWAKEN.|[[???]] dialogue on Wave [[Hidden Wave|???]]}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Awakened Fallen King''' is a boss that appears in the [[Hidden Wave]]. It is the second and later third phase of the [[Fallen King]], it boasts significantly higher health than its first form and possesses more abilities. The '''Awakened Fallen King''' has six abilities: #Its first ability, ''Dramatic Entrance'', only happens when the '''Awakened Fallen King''' first spawns. It will appear slightly in front of the entrance, dropping from the sky. This creates a shockwave upon landing, stunning any tower hit for 5 seconds and deals 200 damage to units. #The second, ''Fallen Comet'', makes it slam its sword into the ground, which creates multiple purple spikes that fall down from the sky, stunning towers for 5 seconds and dealing 50 damage to units. #The third is ''Sword Swing'', which makes it slash its sword three times, with the arc increasing until a full circle area on the last slash. Each slash will stun towers in its area for 6 seconds and deals 100 damage to units. #The fourth and fifth abilities, ''Summon'' and ''Undead Charge'' are both abilities that summon enemies, with the difference being the enemies it summons. ''Summon'' summons forty enemies, which are the [[Fallen Giant]]s with a 40% chance, [[Fallen Shield]]s with a 20% chance and [[Fallen Hero]]es with a 40% chance, while ''Undead Army'' only summons five [[Necrotic Skeleton]]s with a 0.25 second delay between each one. As the ''Summon'' ability can only be used once and the [[Fallen King]] using the ability counts as an '''Awakened Fallen King''' usage, this ability ends up unused in most normal matches. #Its sixth ability is ''Complete Awakening'', which happens when the '''Awakened Fallen King''' has lost 500,000 of its health. It makes it throw away its shield and then do a stomp, stunning all towers hit for 4 seconds. After this ability, the '''Awakened Fallen King''' becomes faster, almost doubling its speed. ==Appearance== The '''Awakened Fallen King''' wears metal armor, with a glowing purple shard-shaped core in the middle and a purple diamond in its waist. He also wears purple boots with small purple shards in the middle of each. Its neon purple right arm only has a shoulder pad, with the armor's "stripes" on the arm being neon pink. The left arm has a shoulder pad and large purple crystals. It wears a metal helmet on its head, which is broken on the left side of its face and reveals a crack in its left eye, both eyes also glowing purple. It wears a crown over the helmet, with the middle of the crown having a purple crystal, the sides having a few purple spikes and the top of the crown having large purple crystals. Compared to its [[Fallen King|original form]], the crystals in the helmet and shoulders are taller and spikier in the awakened form. It wields a large, glowing purple sword with a black handle in its right arm, with the tip of the sword being white and there being two spiky crystals on the sides near the handle. It also wields in its left hand a large metal shield with a glowing purple shard in the middle of it and three purple spikes on the sides. The '''Awakened Fallen King''' has a spawn animation, glitching all the players' screens and smashing the ground, followed by a loud screech and a massive shockwave with purple lightning that stuns towers. When defeated, the '''Awakened Fallen King''' will disintegrate in a purple beam of light and screech loudly. ==Strategy== *Right when the [[Fallen King]] dies, you can use the [[DJ Booth]]'s ''Drop The Beat'' ability on Red track to melt its defense due to it losing the [[Boss]] attribute, which will consequently reduce the defense of the '''Awakened Fallen King'''. **Due to a bug, towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Electroshocker]] and [[Freezer]] can also drop the [[Fallen King]]'s defense, so if you use them in combination, you can effectively remove the defense of the '''Awakened Fallen King''', making it significantly easier to deal with. *Towers that deal high DPS, such as the [[Engineer]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]], [[Gatling Gun]] are highly recommended. **You should try to upgrade all placed towers to max level. The {{Money|50,000}} that [[Hidden Wave]] gives should help with this. *Due to [[Aggro]] enemies directing damage away from the '''Awakened Fallen King''' such as the [[Fallen Shield]], moving towers may be required. *The '''Awakened Fallen King''' alongside the multiple other enemies that can stun like [[Fallen Honor Guard]] will be constantly using their abilities, which results in a large amount of towers being stunned for long periods of time. **The [[Medic]] is therefore recommended. ***It is still recommended to bring stun immune DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]]. **The [[Engineer]] will perform extremely well against the '''Awakened Fallen King''' due to the stunning abilities not having an effect on the [[War Machine Sentry]] when its bubble shield is activated. However, if the [[Engineer]] is not unstunned before another ability which can damage units is performed by the '''Awakened Fallen King''', or another enemy like the [[Fallen Guardian]], then the [[Engineer]]'s effectiveness is dramatically reduced. **The [[Golden Minigunner]] will be heavily affected by the amount of stuns performed due to it having to rev-up after being stunned. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! ErrorBuster.png|Unused '''Awakened Fallen King''' on ''Error Buster'' badge. {{GalleryHeader|Faces}} PatientZeroSmirk.png|'''Awakened Fallen King's''' smirk, which is only present on certain images for the game. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Awakened Fallen King''' is technically not a separate enemy, but instead, the second and later third phase for the [[Fallen King]], as they are the same enemy internally. **Uniquely, unlike other such enemies like the [[Abomination]], it does not change phases shortly after being defeated. It actually takes it multiple waves to appear. **Additionally, multiple parts of the [[Hidden Wave]], such as its wave structure, are also tied to the [[Fallen King]] enemy. **Because of this, the enemies summoned by the '''Awakened Fallen King''' are called "''Fallen King's _____''" instead of "''Awakened Fallen King's _____''". **This is also the reason why the '''Awakened Fallen King''' cannot drop a [[Logbooks|Logbook]] for the '''Awakened Fallen King'''. *An unused version of the '''Awakened Fallen King''' was depicted in the ''Error Buster'' [[Badges|badge]], which was later used for the [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode badge after the 2nd of August 2024. **It was depicted with a similar appearance to the version of the legacy [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]], with purple accents and slightly altered features. **As the '''Awakened Fallen King''' was not widely publicized, it was speculated that the '''Awakened Fallen King''' was cancelled. *The '''Awakened Fallen King''' depicted on the game icon and renders has a large grin similar to [[Patient Zero]], however the '''Awakened Fallen King''' lacks one in-game. *The '''Awakened Fallen King's''' theme has past motifs from Phoqus' previous works. Distinct motifs include the intro of the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]], the second track used in the Hardcore Lobby, [[The Great Finale]] ambience, the original lose theme, the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]'s current theme and the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[DJ Booth]]'s theme. *The '''Awakened Fallen King''' is the first naturally spawning enemy not to spawn at the start of the path. **The '''Awakened Fallen King''' spawns slightly in front of the entrance. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''2 August 2024''' -
